title: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS002
summary:
- Document: SOLANA Engineering Standards and Practices Document No: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS002
- Project: Concentrated solar power plant in Maricopa County, Arizona
- Piping installation subcontractor responsibilities include installing all pipe lines and supports
- Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards for welding
- Confidential information requires permission to reproduce or reveal
- The document outlines standards and practices for piping installation at Solana.
- Field welds for HTF service piping must receive 100% radiographic examination, while other services require 5% visual in-process examinations.
- All carbon steel pipe spools for specific systems must be internally cleaned by the Subcontractor.
- The Subcontractor is responsible for installing all items part of the piping system, including valves and supports.
- Piping for certain specifications must be considered field fabricated.
- Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
- Subcontractor must supply specific materials and fittings for piping installation.
summary_points: Document: SOLANA Engineering Standards and Practices Document No: 4521-ESP-ANC-58-61-PS002
Project: Concentrated solar power plant in Maricopa County, Arizona
Piping installation subcontractor responsibilities include installing all pipe lines and supports
Vendor must comply with ASME B 31.3 standards for welding
Confidential information requires permission to reproduce or reveal
The document outlines standards and practices for piping installation at Solana.
Field welds for HTF service piping must receive 100% radiographic examination, while other services require 5% visual in-process examinations.
All carbon steel pipe spools for specific systems must be internally cleaned by the Subcontractor.
The Subcontractor is responsible for installing all items part of the piping system, including valves and supports.
Piping for certain specifications must be considered field fabricated.
Contract allows alternate billing cycles other than thirty days.
Subcontractor must supply specific materials and fittings for piping installation.
Loose debris must be removed and flushed with water from each spool.
Pressure tests are required before insulation is applied, with Abener Teyma representative witnessing the tests.
Gaskets must be installed using manufacturer recommended torque values.
